text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordanian prime minister meets Iraqi minister of industry and minerals in Amman.
- President Saddam Hussein sends congratulations to Qatari leader for undergoing successful medical operation.
- Saddam receives a number of Iraqi poets on occasion of Great Victory Day -- end of 1980-88 Iraq-Iran war.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and THAWRA)
